item.title: Steps to better code
item.author: map[host:isaaclyman.com username:blog] (Isaac Lyman)
item.description: This is a chapter from Your First Year in Code, a book of practical how-to and advice for new developers. If you’re considering a career in software, check it out. It’s a free download at https://leanpub.com/firstyearincode. When you start out coding, you usually spend a year or two completely oblivious to the rules of “good code.” You may hear words like “elegant” or “clean” tossed around, but you can’t define them.
